notes.title: Update regarding development & Week Long Deal (50% off)
notes.content:
Since our last news we continued the development. Here are the latest news.
We want to celebrate these news with [b]50% off in a Week Long Deal[/b]!

We're reporting our latest progress at our Discord server. [url=https://discord.gg/DzUD7CU98r]Please visit us![/url]

All progress presented in this news are still part of the alpha version we are currently working on. This will await you [b]in future[/b]!

We reached following milestones:
[list]
[*]New coat of whitewash: The entire UI gets a modern upgrade! We presented some of that last year. This time we're done with the options menu and all loading and saving options.
[*]New outfits: Hana gets more outfits which aren't green.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25715694/4f15b9f2af7b05e949333ebcdb12452d964a9872.png[/img]

[*]Back to life: Died? No problem. You will be able to jump back to the decision after dying. Otherwise you can load a save game.
[*]Agony of choice: You will be able to select between 5 text speeds. No patience? Then select the infinity symbol and the text will be displayed at once.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25715694/43887d16b88460a6aed334b69d8164235c503c0a.png[/img]

[*]More slots: More save slots for everyone! We will increase the number of save slots from 5 to 10. You can delete your save games easily if you don't need them anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25715694/25c2437a60415248d521d606a361d67cd71b81d5.png[/img]

[*]Misclicked? No Problem at all. At every crucial decision (loading, saving, etc) there will pop up a window for confirmation.
[*]What's in a name: You will be able to change your player name all the time via the options menu.
[/list]

At the end a small look ahead. We're currently working on these milestones:

[list]
[*]Gallery with profiles which will change during the game.
[*]Bonus content (available after Early access)
[/list]
	
[url=https://discord.gg/DzUD7CU98r]More screenshots at our Discord![/url]

[b]All in this news and on Discord displayed changes of the alpha version are still not available in the playable version.[/b]

notes.title: We continue to develop!
notes.content:
Hello you!

It has been pretty quiet for a long time. Some issues have not been addressed. Since some things have changed, we would now like to communicate more again. In this regard, we want to move [b]our support to Discord[/b]. Unfortunately, the notifications on Steam are shown to us only with difficulty, if at all.

But the biggest news is coming: We switch the engine. Yes, we have to face the disappointment that the game will stay in Early Access for some time. We have to technically develop the game from scratch. Not only does the engine change to create a technically better experience, design also changes fundamentally. Don't worry, our graphics remain. All characters and backgrounds are preserved. Only the graphical user interface is completely renewed. Regarding the subject of music, we are still planning. We don't want to promise anything. If something changes there, we will inform you.

We would like to thank everyone who has supported us so far and hope that everyone will enjoy the new look. It will only take some time ...

We would like to document the progress of the development via our new Discord Server. So if you want to be part of the development, you are very welcome!

https://discord.com/invite/TshAEFJ

Kamiyasoft Team

notes.title: Last route: Jan
notes.content:
[b]A new, huge update awaits you today.[/b]
We're happy to present you the eagerly awaited 5th and last route: Jan!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25715694/cf695f838e181b931062a42be4e1bcb3b49cfffd.png[/img]

[b]Hana[/b] wants to move on. But ... with or without her ex [b]Jan[/b]? Her friends are meddling in this big question that could change her life, but also Jan is trying to convince her to get back to him.

We don't want to deny you the full extent of this update:
[list]
[*][b]International release of the full route "Jan":[/b] 
[list]
[*]English and German text edition
[*]Jan's achievements are unlockable
[*]Jan's gallery content is unlockable
[*]Jan's info boxes are implemented fully
[/list]
[*]Bugfix: One of Blanche's achievements triggered at the false scene. The issue is fixed.
[/list]

Found an error? Please report it at the discussions forum. You can also write an e-mail to support@kamiyasoft.de Thank you very much! ːsgsmileː

The content is complete. The next great step will be to leave early access. Until then, we want to add new functions like auto save.
We also want to deliver a spoiler free achievement guide to you.

Have fun with Jan! Haven't played Tymoteusz, Furio, Einar and/or Blanche yet? Take this chance to do this!

Unfortunately, we have to tell you, that the release of Jan's route will be delayed from to June 2017. We're so sorry and apologize for any inconvenience, but we want to deliver a good game.

The current status so far:

[list]
    [*]Dialogues: Done.
    [*]Correction of dialogues: Done.
    [*]English translation of dialogues: Done.
    [*]Correction of English dialogues: Done.
    [*]Graphics: Two backgrounds still missing.
    [*]Implementation of dialogues:  Done.
    [*]Preparation for scripting: Done.
    [*]Scripting: In full spate!
[/list]

This time we want to present you a feature. This feature will only be available at Jan's route and it's still in progress.
Are you unsure how well Hana's heart is doing? Well, then you will love this interface segment.

notes.title: New route: Childhood friend Furio [Furio ver. 0.3.0]
notes.content:
[b]Today we can present a big update to you (Furio ver. 0.3.0)![/b]
We're happy to present you the 2nd route: Furio!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25715694/20c623df176953f5519d3b226cc41d3df8d48054.png[/img]

Finally, [b]Hana[/b] can date her willing childhood friend [b]Furio[/b]. Sounds like a VN-wise cakewalk? Well, come and take pot luck . ːbiteː

We don't want to deny you the full extent of this update:
[list]
[*][b]International release of the full route "Furio":[/b] 
[list]
[*]English and German text edition
[*]Furio's achievements are unlockable
[*]Furio's gallery content is unlockable
[*]Furio's info boxes are implemented fully
[/list]
[*]Gallery content is extended:
[list]
[*]Character sets are unlockable
[*]CG's are unlockable
[/list]
[*]Minor corrections on the German text edition of "Tymoteusz" and "Prologue"
[*]Visual improvement of decisions
[*]Technical edit of "prologue"
[*]Minor bugfixes
[/list]

Found an error? Please report it at the discussions forum. Thank you very much! ːsgsmileː


At this point we want to announce that we have to exchange the release dates of [b]Einar[/b] and [b]Blanche[/b] because of productional issues. The yuri fans among yourselves have too wait a little longer. We're so sorry. ːcryː But the plushy bear friends can look forward to Einar a little earlier.
Therefore: Einar is expected to be released in Dezember 2016 and Blanche is expected to be released in February 2017. 


We started already with the technical implementing of Einar while the dialogues of Blanche will be written parallel.


Have fun with Furio! Haven't played Tymoteusz yet? Take this chance to do this!

Today we release [b]The Multidimensional Underwear Drawer[/b] alongside with Tymoteusz' route. This will be the first one out of five routes.

We want to start off with little Tymo. Sometimes he will drive Hana to insanity. This comedy route isn't just funny, it's also very deadly. ;) We recommend to save the game regularly.

Please consider that this game is Early Access. Because of that there could be still some errors/bugs. Therefore your opionion of the game is especially important in order to raise the quality.

[*] Implementation of achievements
[/list]
